# SYNESIS_E162 — Warning

## Description

`field_name` in OUTPUT and in TARGET (answer leaks into the prompt).

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: the field `field_name` is in OUTPUT and also in TARGET.
  The answer would be in the prompt, and the model would learn to copy it.
  Instruction and input are joined into the prompt at training time.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **AlpacaFieldLeak**: `block`, `field_name`, `target`
